correctness.rationale: The 24-edge graph gives exactly 36 perfect matchings, 1412 nonempty faces. Two independent face enumerations agree. A 696-pair acyclic Forman matching with 5004 directed Hasse incidences and exactly one zero-cell plus nineteen two-cells proves an integral wedge of 19 two-spheres. Reverse element order and independent mod-two ranks verify additional boundaries. Exact signed Lefschetz fixed-face sums on all 24 dihedral elements prove the complete rational degree-two character.

value.rationale: A canonical four-regular dihedrally symmetric antiprism yields a pure five-dimensional but nonshellable perfect-matching complex of 19 two-spheres. The complete natural symmetry character and classification of 120 minimal nonextendible matchings give structural information not implied by a facet count, Euler characteristic or the existing line-tiling classifications; no arbitrary graph or family extension is claimed.
